title: OR gate evaluation criterion
statement: Let $m$ be a nonnegative integer, let $v:\text{Fin}(m)\to\{\pm1\}$ be a sign assignment, and let $S\subseteq\text{Fin}(m)$. The OR gate evaluates to $-1$ on $S$ exactly when some index in $S$ has assigned value $-1$.
